interest: Shows US alarm over dual-citizen Nisei conscription into Japan's military, spurring State-War-Navy-Justice inquiries and a Hawaii court citizenship case.
overview: Docket (1940-44) on alleged Nisei conscription into Japan's military in Hawaii and California, spurring multi-agency inquiries, a Hawaii expatriation case, and reports on Japan's expanding draft age and Russian emigre mobilization abroad.

subfiles.about: A three-page Department of State List of Papers indexing and summarizing communications and intelligence reports concerning Japanese military conscription and the status of dual-citizen Japanese Americans from 1940 to 1944.
subfiles.summary: Lists 1940-44 records on alleged conscription of Japanese-American citizens in Hawaii and California into Japan's military, Hawaii expatriation rulings, and overseas reports on Russian emigre mobilization and expanding draft ages.
